TestCase.name: testInnerJoinPreservesFilterAndFields
TestCase.Resource: SELECT a, b, x, y FROM src JOIN LATERAL TABLE(tf(a, f3(f5(a, b), b))) AS T(x, y) ON y > 0

LogicalProject(a=[$0], b=[$1], x=[$2], y=[$3]) +- LogicalCorrelate(correlation=[$cor0], joinType=[inner], requiredColumns=[{0, 1}]) :- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, src]]) +- LogicalFilter(condition=[>($1, 0)]) +- LogicalTableFunctionScan(invocation=[tf($cor0.a, f3(f5($cor0.a, $cor0.b), $cor0.b))], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER x, INTEGER y)])

Calc(select=[a, b, x, y], where=[>(y, 0)]) +- PythonCorrelate(invocation=[tf($0, f3($2, $1))], correlate=[table(tf(a,f3(f0, b)))], select=[a,b,f0,x,y], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER a, INTEGER b, INTEGER f0, INTEGER x, INTEGER y)], joinType=[INNER]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, b, f5(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, src]], fields=[a, b])

TestCase.name: testLeftJoinPreservesFieldsAcrossFunctionKinds
TestCase.Resource: SELECT a, b, x, y FROM src LEFT JOIN LATERAL TABLE(tf(a, f3(vector5(a, b), b))) AS T(x, y) ON TRUE

LogicalProject(a=[$0], b=[$1], x=[$2], y=[$3]) +- LogicalCorrelate(correlation=[$cor0], joinType=[left], requiredColumns=[{0, 1}]) :- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, src]]) +- LogicalTableFunctionScan(invocation=[tf($cor0.a, f3(vector5($cor0.a, $cor0.b), $cor0.b))], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER x, INTEGER y)])

Calc(select=[a, b, x, y]) +- PythonCorrelate(invocation=[tf($0, f3($2, $1))], correlate=[table(tf(a,f3(f0, b)))], select=[a,b,f0,x,y], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER a, INTEGER b, INTEGER f0, INTEGER x, INTEGER y)], joinType=[LEFT]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, b, vector5(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, src]], fields=[a, b])

TestCase.name: testLeftJoinPreservesFieldsAfterAsyncExtraction
TestCase.Resource: SELECT a, b, x, y FROM src LEFT JOIN LATERAL TABLE(tf(f3(async_func(a, b), b), f5(a, b))) AS T(x, y) ON TRUE

LogicalProject(a=[$0], b=[$1], x=[$2], y=[$3]) +- LogicalCorrelate(correlation=[$cor0], joinType=[left], requiredColumns=[{0, 1}]) :- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, src]]) +- LogicalTableFunctionScan(invocation=[tf(f3(async_func($cor0.a, $cor0.b), $cor0.b), f5($cor0.a, $cor0.b))], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER x, INTEGER y)])

Calc(select=[a, b, x, y]) +- PythonCorrelate(invocation=[tf($3, f5($0, $1))], correlate=[table(tf(f00,f5(a, b)))], select=[a,b,f0,f00,x,y], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER a, INTEGER b, INTEGER f0, INTEGER f00, INTEGER x, INTEGER y)], joinType=[LEFT]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, b, f0, f3(f0, b) AS f00]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[a, b, async_func(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, src]], fields=[a, b])

TestCase.name: testPreservesSharedPythonResultAcrossAsyncExtraction
TestCase.Resource: SELECT p, x, y FROM (SELECT a, b, plain(a, b) AS p FROM src), LATERAL TABLE(tf(async_func(p, b), p)) AS T(x, y)

LogicalProject(p=[$2], x=[$3], y=[$4]) +- LogicalCorrelate(correlation=[$cor0], joinType=[inner], requiredColumns=[{1, 2}]) :- LogicalProject(a=[$0], b=[$1], p=[plain($0, $1)]) : +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, src]]) +- LogicalTableFunctionScan(invocation=[tf(async_func($cor0.p, $cor0.b), $cor0.p)], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER x, INTEGER y)])

Calc(select=[p, x, y]) +- PythonCorrelate(invocation=[tf($3, $2)], correlate=[table(tf(f0,p))], select=[a,b,p,f0,x,y], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER a, INTEGER b, INTEGER p, INTEGER f0, INTEGER x, INTEGER y)], joinType=[INNER]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[a, b, p, async_func(p, b) AS f0]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, b, plain(a, b) AS p]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, src]], fields=[a, b])

TestCase.name: testSplitsConcurrencyAfterAsyncExtraction
TestCase.Resource: SELECT x, y FROM src, LATERAL TABLE(tf(f3(async_func(a, b), b), f5(a, b))) AS T(x, y)

LogicalProject(x=[$2], y=[$3]) +- LogicalCorrelate(correlation=[$cor0], joinType=[inner], requiredColumns=[{0, 1}]) :- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, src]]) +- LogicalTableFunctionScan(invocation=[tf(f3(async_func($cor0.a, $cor0.b), $cor0.b), f5($cor0.a, $cor0.b))], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER x, INTEGER y)])

Calc(select=[x, y]) +- PythonCorrelate(invocation=[tf($3, f5($0, $1))], correlate=[table(tf(f00,f5(a, b)))], select=[a,b,f0,f00,x,y], rowType=[RecordType(INTEGER a, INTEGER b, INTEGER f0, INTEGER f00, INTEGER x, INTEGER y)], joinType=[INNER]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, b, f0, f3(f0, b) AS f00]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[a, b, async_func(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, src]], fields=[a, b])
